Ami.reason: Ami refers to AMI (Adjusted Mutual Information), a chance‑corrected clustering metric, not the Ami language; thus false_positive.

Ari.reason: Ari refers to ARI (Adjusted Rand Index), a chance‑corrected clustering metric, not the Ari language; thus false_positive.

Hungarian.reason: Hungarian refers to Hungarian matching (the assignment algorithm), not the Hungarian language; thus false_positive.
